operator_io_quirks: No declared FOREIGN KEY constraints anywhere (fks empty for all 6 tables); join semantics (employee.Dno=department.Dnumber, works_on.Essn=employee.Ssn, works_on.Pno=project.Pnumber, employee.Super_ssn=employee.Ssn, department.Mgr_ssn=employee.Ssn, project.Dnum=department.Dnumber, dependent.Essn=employee.Ssn, dept_locations.Dnumber=department.Dnumber) exist only in data, so TS will NOT fill them consistently.
Self-reference employee.Super_ssn -> employee.Ssn is undeclared; TS treats it as a plain Number column, so supervisors will not exist as employees.
Composite PKs: works_on(Essn,Pno), dependent(Essn,Dependent_name), dept_locations(Dnumber,Dlocation) -> composite-PK members get max_l0=30 cap; PK dedup drops rows.
Bdate and Mgr_start_date are TEXT-stored dates in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format; declared type TEXT dispatches to String fuzzer, not Date, so TS emits random charset strings, not dates.
All columns notnull=0 (no NOT NULL), no CHECK, no UNIQUE indexes -> nothing fails at insert; rows_failed ~0.
Tiny tables (3-16 rows): original_values sampling k=min(5,len) is small; department has only 3 rows so 5 draws with replacement heavily repeat.
Mixed-case column names (Super_ssn, Mgr_ssn, Mgr_start_date, Dependent_name, Dnumber vs Dno) and table names lowercase; identifiers must be quoted.
Sex columns have distinct=2 ('M','F') but declared TEXT -> String fuzzer, no enum awareness.
Salary INTEGER with values 25000-55000; Number fuzzer range [-10^0,10^0] for scale 0 -> TS emits ~[-1,1] integers, wildly off.
Ssn/phone-like INTEGERs (9-digit) declared INTEGER scale 0 -> Number fuzzer produces tiny ints, breaking join plausibility.
Hours REAL with null_rate 0.062; Number float perturb +-0.01/0.02.
Pno/Pnumber share values 1,2,3,10,20,30 across project and works_on; Dno/Dnumber share 1,4,5 across employee/department/project/dept_locations.
operator_ts_expectations: String fuzzer on Fname/Minit/Lname/Address/Dname/Pname/Plocation/Dlocation/Relationship/Dependent_name: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings length 0-20 with 50% contaminate -> implausible names, addresses, locations.
String fuzzer on Bdate/Mgr_start_date: random strings, not dates -> date comparisons (BETWEEN, <, >) become meaningless; likely FN when gold filters by date range.

Number fuzzer on Ssn/Super_ssn/Mgr_ssn/Essn: scale 0 -> range [-1,1] plus perturb; 9-digit SSNs never reproduced -> joins on Ssn/Super_ssn/Mgr_ssn almost always empty -> FN for self-join / manager queries.
Number fuzzer on Salary: [-1,1] -> salary thresholds (e.g. >30000) always false or always true -> FN/FP.
Number fuzzer on Dno/Dnumber/Dnum/Pno/Pnumber: tiny ints; since no declared FKs, cross-table joins on these columns rarely match -> FN for join queries.
Number fuzzer on Hours: floats in [-1,1] plus perturb; hours>10 filters flip.
No FK constraints -> fill_foreign_keys_consistently never runs; each column sampled independently -> referential integrity absent -> FN for any join.
Composite PK dedup on works_on/dependent/dept_locations drops duplicate (Essn,Pno) etc.; with tiny Number ranges many collisions -> small tables.
String fuzzer on Sex: random strings, not 'M'/'F' -> WHERE Sex='F' returns empty -> FN.
String fuzzer on Relationship: random strings, not 'Son'/'Daughter'/'Spouse' -> FN.
Literal pool from train SQL seeds real values (e.g. 'Research','Houston','M','F') with p=0.2 element reuse; some plausibility leaks through, but 0.3 chance whole instance p=0 -> pure random.

Tiny original tables mean original_values contribute few distinct seeds; TS mostly fresh-random -> low overlap with gold predicates -> FN dominates; FP from missing ties when aggregates (COUNT DISTINCT) collapse.
